chart.description: Displays Percentile distribution of memory consumption percentage reported from OTel hosts
chart.name: Memory utilization

noDataOptions.linkText: Get stated with the OpenTelemetry Collector
noDataOptions.noDataMessage: No active metrics found. This chart requires the OpenTelemetry collector to be installed on your Compute Engine instances.

chart.programText:
A = data('system.memory.usage', filter=filter('cloud.platform', 'gcp_compute_engine') and filter('state', 'used')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('system.memory.usage', filter=filter('cloud.platform', 'gcp_compute_engine') and filter('state', 'used', 'buffered', 'free', 'cached')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A/B)*100).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).min().publish(label='D')
E = (C).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='E')
F = (C).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='F')
G = (C).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='G')
H = (C).max().publish(label='H')
